artworks.title: Birds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows multiple birds on and around a small, leafy tree. The birds are a variety of colors and sizes, including birds that look like hawks, blue jays, hummingbirds, magpies, and kestrels. They are shades of black, white, brown, gray, red, yellow, and pale blue. The birds are positioned at various heights on the small tree and on the ground below, all facing different directions. The ground is green, with small grasses and ferns, and the sky behind the tree is pale yellow.

artworks.title: The Congdon Brothers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. They both have light brown hair, light skin, round eyes, and slightly flushed cheeks. They are wearing deep blue garments with white ruffled collars and two yellow buttons. The background is a flat, dark brown color.

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Lady Wearing Spectacles
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Catherine A. May
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Eliza R. Read
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is seated, facing slightly to her right but looking directly at the viewer. Her facial features are characterized by a solemn expression, with prominent cheekbones, light skin, and dark eyes. Her brown hair is styled tightly on top of her head, adorned with a delicate lace headpiece. The woman is dressed in a formal, black gown with voluminous sleeves, accented by a sheer, lace shawl with intricate patterns draped over her shoulders. She wears a long, fine gold chain around her neck, and a gold earring in her ear. In her right hand, she holds a white handkerchief. Behind her is a vibrant green background, with gold lettering to her left reading "ELIZA R. READ BORN FEB' 19. 1811. PAINTED OCT' 1833." She is sitting on an upholstered piece of furniture with a patterned orange design.

artworks.title: John G. Read
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man with fair complexion and light brown hair, depicted in a half-length portrait. He is seated, facing forward with a slight tilt to his left. The man has sharp eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a defined nose, and lips, creating a composed expression. He is dressed in a formal black coat over a white shirt with intricate ruffles, and holds a red book in his right hand. A red and gold textile is draped over the armrest of his chair. The background is solid green. Text on the left side of the image states "JOHN G. READ BORN NOV' 1, 1799 PAINTED OCT' 1833."

artworks.title: Sisters in Blue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows two young children standing together. The child on the left has fuller cheeks and tightly curled brown hair, while the child on the right has longer, less curly hair. Both are dressed in blue dresses with white lace-trimmed sleeves and white pantaloons with lace. They wear blue shoes. The child on the left is holding red cherries, some of which are on the ground, and the child on the right holds a red book with a partially visible white page. The background is a simple, dark tone.

artworks.title: Susanna Truax
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: View of Concord
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with hills and a river or lake in the distance. Several buildings, including a church, are scattered across the land. Soldiers in red and white uniforms are lined up near a stone wall and gravestones in the foreground. The sky is blue with a few scattered clouds. The painting style uses precise brushstrokes, featuring a color palette of soft blues, greens, reds, and muted tones.

artworks.title: John Adams
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a balding, light-skinned man wears a port-red vest and coat in this vertical portrait painting. The man’s shoulders are angled to our right, but he turns his head to look at us from the corners of gray eyes under heavy, brown brows. His under-eyes are shaded blue and lined with wrinkles. He has a bumped nose, bow-shaped lips, a round chin, fleshy, flushed cheeks, and sagging jowls. His white hair sweeps up and to either side of a bald patch, painted with a white sheen, on the top of his head. Curls come down over each ear and longer hair in the back is tied with a black ribbon. He wears a white ruffled cravat under the deep red vest and coat, both of which have gold-colored buttons down the front. The background lightens from earth brown in the upper left corner to paler, peanut brown in the lower right.

artworks.title: James Madison
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a cleanshaven man with pale, rosy skin and curled white hair looks off to our right against a dark, olive-green curtain in the background of this vertical portrait painting. His shoulders are angled slightly to our right, and he looks into the distance with blue eyes. His right brow, to our left, is arched, and his eyes are deeply set. His flushed cheeks and jowls sag a bit around his closed mouth, and there are lines under his eyes. His white gray hair seems to be pulled back from his forehead and swells in bushy curls over his ears. Part of a black ribbon seen beyond his shoulder may tie his hair back. He wears a bright white, high-necked, ruffled shirt under a black jacket. Light illuminates the man and the green curtain from our left.

artworks.title: James Monroe
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This painting depicts a man from the waist up. He is looking at us, his body turned slightly to the left. The man has fair skin, blue eyes, short gray wavy hair, a cleft chin, and prominent ears. He is dressed in a black coat with a high collar and a white cravat. The background is a blend of muted colors in brown, pale pink, and gray hues.

artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Jefferson Coolidge IV in memory of his great-grandfather, Thomas Jefferson Coolidge, his grandfather, Thomas Jefferson Coolidge II, and his father, Thomas Jefferson Coolidge III
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a cleanshaven, middle-aged man with pale skin and silvery gray hair, wearing a white, ruffled shirt under a velvety black, high-necked jacket, looks out at us in this vertical portrait painting. His body is angled to our left, and he turns his face slightly to look at us with gray eyes under slightly arched eyebrows. He has a long nose and his thin lips are closed in a straight line. Shadows define slightly sagging jowls along his jawline and down his neck. His light gray hair is pulled back from his forehead and swells in bushy curls over his ears. Part of a black ribbon seen beyond his shoulder ties his hair back. Light illuminates the person from our left and creates a golden glow on the light brown background behind him.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with Travelers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict and Bertha B. Leubsdorf in memory of Sophie and Carl Boschwitz
artworks.description: The painting shows a forested landscape from an elevated angle. The horizon is high in the composition, with a blue sky and fluffy white clouds in the background. A large, gnarled tree trunk is in the center, with more tall trees behind it, their leaves in shades of dark green and rusty red. In the bottom left corner, we can see a group of people gathered on the dark brown ground. They are in shadow, but we can see their clothes, which are in shades of red, brown, black, and white. Three of them wear wide-brimmed hats, while the fourth appears to be a woman with her hair pulled back in a bun. More people are visible in the distance on the right, wearing similar clothing. In the center, behind the tall tree trunk, a light brown path curves up a hill and into the woods in the distance.

artworks.title: The Marketplace in Bergen op Zoom
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Earl H. Look
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a scene with people gathering in small groups in a cobblestone town square lined with rows of brick, wood, and stone buildings, many with stepped rooflines, in this horizontal painting. Singly or in pairs or trios, men, women, and children walk across the square, move goods around, or talk to merchants. All the people have light skin. Many of the men have mustaches and wear hats, and some carry swords. In tones of black, olive green, brick red, and plum purple, they wear hip-length cloaks over jackets, with white collars or ruffs and brass buttons, and knee-length breeches over yellow or black stockings. The women all wear long dresses in salmon pink, coral red, or golden yellow, with white collars or ruffs, and many wear black, ankle-length cloaks, some with hoods. Closest to us, a sumptuously dressed man and woman walk toward us while another similarly elegant couple walks away. Also facing away from us, to our left, a man wearing a large drum strapped around his waist raises one drumstick as he looks over his left shoulder. Nearby, a woman peers up out of a cellar door that opens on an angle to the street. More couples gather around a well across the square, and two women and a child talk to a third woman selling wares at a wooden table to our right. A pair of hooded priests or monks walk near a man blowing on a trumpet on horseback. The buildings are mostly shades of brick red and brown, and most have three or four stories with steeply pitched roofs. More people walk along side streets leading off the main square. One gap in the buildings across from us leads to a nickel-gray stone church with a pointed spire and square tower. A grassy, green hill rises steeply beyond the buildings to our right, leading down to a waterway that extends up and away into the distance. A few boats float in the water, which reflects the leaden-gray sky. Beyond the town square, a brown stone structure like a fortress with turret towers and crenellated walls looms along the ridge of the hill to our right. Tiny in scale, people on horseback and tending sheep dot the hillside below. The date “1590” is painted on the front of one of the buildings across from us while another date, “1597,” is painted on the end of a short wall near the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Lady Cunliffe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Josephine Tompkins
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman from the waist up, her forearms resting on a brown surface in front of her. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, light blue eyes, and blonde hair styled in loose curls. She wears a yellow wide-brimmed hat with a bow tied under her chin, a yellow scarf, and a pale-yellow lacy dress with long sleeves and wide neckline. The background is a blend of yellow and black.

artworks.title: Two Nudes [obverse]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Wilhelmina and Wallace F. Holladay and Ruth and Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: This tall, vertical painting shows two nude women next to each other, one standing and one sitting. The women both have light skin painted in shades of cream and pale yellow, with highlights of seafoam green, dark blue, and magenta. The seated woman faces us, turned slightly to the right, while the standing woman has her back to us, facing the left and partially blocking the seated woman. Both women appear to have dark hair, although their hair and the edges of their faces blur together against a patch of dark green in the background. Outside of this green patch, the wall behind them is a vibrant orange with streaks of dark and light green. The floor beneath the women is a bright coral color with swirling patterns in yellow and green, like a patterned rug. Below the chair under the seated woman is a patch of dark red with dark green lines. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and bold, layering bright colors over one another.

artworks.title: Nude Figure [reverse]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Wilhelmina and Wallace F. Holladay and Ruth and Jacob Kainen
artworks.description: In this tall, thin painting, a nude person stands in a strange position. Their lower body is seen from the back, while their upper body appears to face us, with their head turned towards the left. The individual has light skin and short, dark hair styled close to their scalp, partially covering their forehead. The person holds a thin white fabric or cloth in both hands, and it appears to drape around their shoulders and behind them. The background features a bold palette of colors, with a vivid yellow area on the top and right and a black rectangle on the left, framing the figure's lower body. The floor beneath the figure is a muted green color.

artworks.title: Florence Sittenham Davey (Mrs. Randall Davey)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Florence S. McCormick
artworks.description: This painting is a portrait of a seated woman shown from the knees upwards. She is seated in a woven yellow armchair, with her right arm resting on one arm of the chair, while her left hand rests on her lap. The chair is slightly turned to the left, but she looks directly at us. She has pale skin with slightly pink cheeks, round blue-green eyes, thin brown eyebrows, and pink lips set in a neutral expression. Her hair is dark brown and styled in soft waves, visible beneath a wide-brimmed cream hat adorned with a striped green-and-white band. The woman wears a white dress with a green belt or sash around the waist and a pearl necklace. A green cloth appears to be draped on the chair beneath her, and the background is a deep blend of green, dark blue, and black shades, similar to a heavy draped curtain. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and visible.

artworks.title: The Loge
artworks.dimensions:
support: 12.7 x 21.9 cm (5 x 8 5/8 in.)
overall (support and wooden collar): 14 x 22.8 cm (5 1/2 x 9 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emily M. Wilson in memory of Anthony T. Wilson
artworks.description: Upon first glance, the shapes and colors in this painting are hard to distinguish. After closer inspection, three women become visible, all with pale skin, light hair, and indistinct facial features. On the left, the back of a woman's head and shoulder are visible as she leans toward the edge of a low wall or balcony. She wears a dark blue, off-the-shoulder dress with a black neckline. Next to her, on the right, is a woman in profile, looking to the left. In her hair there is a bright red accessory, perhaps a flower or the side of an earmuff. She wears a pink dress with a ruffled neckline, a black necklace high on her neck, and a small white earring. She holds a black fan near her face. In the background, behind them, is a dancer in a green dress, her arms extended above her head. The two women in the balcony look out at the dancer. The ground beneath the dancer is light brown, and the background behind her is abstract, with soft hues of green and orange. A red curtain frames the woman in the balcony to the left, and there is a black curtain on the right.

artworks.title: Elizabeth Gray Otis (Mrs. Samuel Alleyne Otis)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Honorable and Mrs. Robert H. Thayer
artworks.description: This painting is a portrait of a woman. She has fair skin, a straight nose, and thin red lips, with her dark hair styled up with flowers. She is wearing a multi-colored dress with voluminous sleeves, a wide neckline, and a sheer golden scarf. The woman is sitting and holding a hooked staff in one hand and a thin ribbon in the other. Behind her is a landscape background with a large tree on the left and a cloudy sky on the right.

artworks.title: Samuel Alleyne Otis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Honorable and Mrs. Robert H. Thayer
